title: Agentic Hardware Design as Repository-Level Code Evolution
title_zh: 将 Agentic 硬件设计视为仓库级代码演化
abstract_en: We present HORIZON, a self-evolving agent framework that treats hardware design as repository-level code evolution. A Markdown harness is compiled into a project pack containing domain knowledge, an executable evaluator, an acceptance predicate, and a git/runtime policy; a hands-free agent loop then evolves an isolated git worktree, using repository operations for state management, tracing, and replay. This extends prior works of repository-scale self-evolution from EDA software systems, to hardware-design artifacts themselves. We evaluate our approach on ChipBench, RTLLM, Verilog-Eval, and nine CVDP categories, achieving 100\% benchmark completion across all suites with a fully hands-free agentic loop. However, we do not claim that agentic AI for hardware design is solved: these benchmarks are controlled proxies for a much broader engineering problem in chip design. Section~\ref{sec:discuss} examines the limitations of the current study and highlights open research challenges.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 HORIZON，一个自演化智能体框架，将硬件设计建模为仓库级代码演化问题。该方法把 Markdown harness 编译为 project pack，其中包含领域知识、可执行评测器、验收谓词以及 git/runtime 策略；随后通过无需人工干预的智能体循环，在隔离的 git worktree 中持续演化设计，并利用仓库操作进行状态管理、追踪与回放。HORIZON 将此前面向 EDA 软件系统的仓库级自演化思想扩展到硬件设计产物本身。实验在 ChipBench、RTLLM、Verilog-Eval 以及九类 CVDP 任务上进行，所有基准均达到 100% 完成率，展示了全自动 agentic loop 在受控硬件设计代理任务中的有效性。但作者强调，这并不意味着 agentic AI 已解决硬件设计问题；现有基准仍只是芯片设计复杂工程问题的受控代理，论文也讨论了当前研究限制与开放挑战。
key_points_zh: 提出 HORIZON，自演化 agent 框架，将硬件设计转化为 repository-level code evolution。
通过 Markdown harness 生成 project pack，集成领域知识、评测器、验收条件和 git/runtime 策略。
智能体在隔离 git worktree 中全自动修改、评测、回溯与重放硬件设计代码。
在 ChipBench、RTLLM、Verilog-Eval 和九类 CVDP 上实现 100% benchmark completion。
作者明确指出结果来自受控基准，真实芯片设计仍面临规模、验证、规范理解和工程集成等开放挑战。

llm_assessment.comment: HORIZON is strong agent-harness work because it combines executable evaluators, acceptance predicates, git-based state management, tracing, replay, and hands-free repository evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: HORIZON 价值较高，因为它结合了可执行评估器、验收谓词、基于 git 的状态管理、追踪、回放和自动化仓库演化。
